title: Per-second income calculation + 24/7 accrual
description: Each machine has daily_rate MMK. Server computes (now - start_time) * daily_rate / 86400. Frontend ticks every second updating displayed balance from server-anchored start_time. Implement as a Supabase Edge Function (cron-style) or computed on read. Verify the math: L1=2000/86400, L2=4000/86400, L3=7000/86400, L5=11000/86400, Super=24000/86400.
notes: Computed-on-read approach: v_user_balance view sums rate_per_sec × EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - start_time)) over active user_machines. BalanceTicker fetches v_user_balance_snapshot every 30s, interpolates 1Hz. No cron needed. NUMERIC(18,8) storage avoids float drift.
close_reason: Per-second math verified (1 day = 86400s). L1=2000/86400=0.023148, L2=0.046296, L3=0.081019, L5=0.127315, Super=0.277778 MMK/s. Implementation: computed-on-read via v_level_rate + v_user_balance views (NUMERIC(18,8) no float drift). Client uses v_user_balance_snapshot fetched every 30s and interpolates at 1Hz. No cron needed.
